label: Whatever has every Dei Filius attribute has the primitive classical-attributes field
paraphrase: Open premise, analyst formulation: every being that has every Dei Filius attribute in the typed reading of definition edcfac86 (DeiFiliusAttributes) has the skeleton's primitive field HasClassicalAttributes. The field interpretation on the full-list reading CLASSICAL_FIELD_2, stated one-way with no converse. It is not what Root.lean documents: there the field is 'intended to group simplicity, perfection, goodness, infinity, immutability, eternity, unity, intellect and will', the nine (CLASSICAL_FIELD_1), on which reading this premise follows at once. The Dei Filius motivation is in ClassicalAttributesSuffice's docstring, DEF-CLASSICAL-ATTRIBUTES-BUNDLE and the claim. It is strictly weaker than STMT-CLASSICAL-ATTRIBUTES-SUFFICE by the Lean lemma fieldOfSuffice (lake-checked; not a registered result, so not Comparator-verified) and Control.Controls part 3. It supplies no existence witness.
